Onboarding.title: Onboarding case
Onboarding.description: A deterministic onboarding case (one per hire): the concrete legal gates for a new employee's first week — contract signed, WID identity check, BSN/IBAN validated, IT provisioned, pensioen aangemeld — as checklist boolean/date fields, governed by a simplified six-state declarative lifecycle (onboarding-wizard-mvp). MVP-scoped from the 2026-05 spec/onboarding-wizard draft's 13-state machine and 15-step wizard stepper: no OnboardingStep/WIDCheck/BSNValidatie/Reminder side entities, no wizard stepper UI (follow-up nc-vue widget, design.md D6), no BSN elfproef/IBAN modulus-97 validation services, no IT auto-provisioning, no reminder/escalation engine. The checklist gates named on each lifecycle transition are enforced by audit rules (lib/Standards/Checks/NlOnboardingChecks.php), NOT by write-time guard classes — guard wiring for compliance-checked schemas is owned by the active humaniq-rule-compliance-enforcement change (design.md D2).

contract_bevestigen.description: The employment contract has been signed. Checklist gate: contractSigned = true (enforced by audit rule, not a write-time guard — see humaniq-rule-compliance-enforcement).

gegevens_valideren.description: The hire's BSN and IBAN have been checked. Checklist gate: bsnValidated = true AND ibanVerified = true (audit-enforced).

gereed_melden.description: The case is ready for the first workday. Checklist gate: widCheckDone = true (WID check on or before startDate, Wet op de identificatieplicht art. 15 jo. Wet LB 1964 art. 28 lid 1 onder f), itProvisioned = true, pensioenAangemeld = true (audit-enforced).

starten.description: startDate has been reached; the proeftijd clock now runs against proeftijdEndDate (BW 7:652).

afronden.description: The proeftijd completed without termination; the onboarding case is closed out.

annuleren.description: The hire is cancelled (no-show, or proeftijd termination) before the case reaches afgerond.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: UUID reference to the Employee this onboarding case hires.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: First workday. Anchor date for the WID identity check timing (nl-onboarding-wid-check) and the proeftijd clock.

proeftijdEndDate.title: Proeftijd end date
proeftijdEndDate.description: End of the probationary period, if agreed. BW 7:652-capped (max 1 month for fixed-term contracts under 2 years, max 2 months for permanent/2+ year contracts) but a contractual input, not derived — checked by nl-onboarding-proeftijd-bewaking. Null when no proeftijd was agreed.

status.title: Status
status.description: Case lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (aangenomen -> contract_getekend -> gegevens_gevalideerd -> gereed_eerste_werkdag -> proeftijd_lopend -> afgerond, cancellable pre-afgerond).

contractSigned.title: Contract signed
contractSigned.description: Whether the signed employment contract is on file (artefact stored in the files widget). Gates the contract_bevestigen transition.

widCheckDone.title: WID check done
widCheckDone.description: Whether the WID identity check was performed (original document seen, copy retained per Wet LB 1964 art. 28 lid 1 onder f). Must be true on or before startDate; checked by nl-onboarding-wid-check.

widCheckDate.title: WID check date
widCheckDate.description: Date the WID identity check was performed.

bsnValidated.title: BSN validated
bsnValidated.description: Whether the BSN was checked. Records the outcome only — elfproef modulus-11 automation is a non-goal.

ibanVerified.title: IBAN verified
ibanVerified.description: Whether the IBAN was verified. Records the outcome only — modulus-97 automation is a non-goal.

itProvisioned.title: IT provisioned
itProvisioned.description: Whether the Nextcloud/IT account was provisioned for the hire. Records the outcome only — OCS auto-provisioning is a non-goal.

pensioenAangemeld.title: Pensioen aangemeld
pensioenAangemeld.description: Whether the hire has been registered with the pension fund/administrator.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Denormalized administratie key this Onboarding case is scoped to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7), mirroring its employee's administrationId; maintained by HR/back-office and audited for drift by nl-administratie-scope-consistency (REQ-MULTI-007). The implicit page scoping (REQ-MULTI-004) filters on it.

Offboarding.title: Offboarding case
Offboarding.description: A deterministic offboarding case (one per departure): the concrete gates for a leaving employee — exit interview held, assets returned, access revoked — and the statutory eindafrekening components (verlofsaldo paid out, vakantiegeld settled, transitievergoeding recorded, getuigschrift provided) as checklist boolean/date fields, governed by a simplified five-state declarative lifecycle (offboarding-wizard-mvp). MVP-scoped from the 2026-05 spec/offboarding-wizard draft's 17-state machine and 7 entity schemas: no OffboardingStep/Eindafrekening/EquipmentReturn/ExitInterview/Getuigschrift/RetentionTimer side entities, no eindafrekening computation engine, no UWV WW-melding/pensioenfonds/ZVW submissions, no AVG retention timers, no per-item asset tracking (the parallel asset-management-mvp owns asset data — loose coupling only, design.md D6). The checklist gates named on each lifecycle transition are enforced by audit rules (lib/Standards/Checks/NlOffboardingChecks.php), NOT by write-time guard classes — guard wiring for compliance-checked schemas is owned by the active humaniq-rule-compliance-enforcement change (design.md D2).

afronding_plannen.description: lastWorkingDay is confirmed; the exit gesprek, asset return and access revocation are planned (no field gate on this transition).

eindafrekening_gereedmelden.description: The eindafrekening is ready. Checklist gate: verlofsaldoUitbetaald = true when an open leave balance remains (BW 7:641), vakantiegeldAfgerekend = true, transitievergoedingBedrag recorded for dismissal-initiated reasons (BW 7:673) (enforced by audit rule, not a write-time guard — see humaniq-rule-compliance-enforcement).

afronden.description: The case is closed out. Checklist gate: exitGesprekDone recorded, assetsIngeleverd = true, toegangIngetrokken = true, getuigschriftVerstrekt on request (BW 7:656), Employee.endDate equals lastWorkingDay (BW 7:667) (audit-enforced).

annuleren.description: The departure is withdrawn (opzegging ingetrokken / VSO niet getekend) before the case reaches afgerond.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: UUID reference to the Employee this offboarding case concerns.

lastWorkingDay.title: Last working day
lastWorkingDay.description: The employee's last working day; anchor date for the einddatum-consistentie rule (nl-offboarding-einddatum-consistentie, BW 7:667).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: The departure reason. Drives transitievergoeding applicability (BW 7:673) — opzegging-werkgever and einde-contract (non-renewal) are dismissal-initiated; opzegging-werknemer, pensioen and overlijden are statutorily exempt; vso severance is negotiated, not statutory.

status.title: Status
status.description: Case lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (aangekondigd -> afronding_gepland -> eindafrekening_gereed -> afgerond, cancellable pre-afgerond).

exitGesprekDone.title: Exit gesprek done
exitGesprekDone.description: Date the exit interview was held; null while pending. Gates the afronden transition.

assetsIngeleverd.title: Assets ingeleverd
assetsIngeleverd.description: Whether company property was returned. Records the outcome only — per-item tracking is the parallel asset-management-mvp's domain (design.md D6).

toegangIngetrokken.title: Toegang ingetrokken
toegangIngetrokken.description: Whether Nextcloud/IT access has been revoked. Records the outcome only — OCS automation is a non-goal.

verlofsaldoUitbetaald.title: Verlofsaldo uitbetaald
verlofsaldoUitbetaald.description: Whether the open leave balance was paid out (BW art. 7:641). Checked cross-object by nl-offboarding-verlofsaldo-uitbetaling against the employee's LeaveBalance rows.

vakantiegeldAfgerekend.title: Vakantiegeld afgerekend
vakantiegeldAfgerekend.description: Whether accrued vakantiegeld was settled in the eindafrekening.

transitievergoedingBedrag.title: Transitievergoeding bedrag
transitievergoedingBedrag.description: Gross statutory transition payment in EUR (BW art. 7:673); required data for dismissal-initiated reasons, null when not applicable. Recorded input, not derived — the formula constants live as parameters on the nl-offboarding-transitievergoeding rule.

getuigschriftVerstrekt.title: Getuigschrift verstrekt
getuigschriftVerstrekt.description: Whether the getuigschrift was provided to the leaver (BW art. 7:656; generated via the existing docudesk getuigschrift document type).
